enchantment.merlinlib.unbreakable.desc: Locks the durability of an item. The first time it would be damaged it is repaired fully, and after that it never wears out.

gui.merlinlib.macro.name: Name

gui.merlinlib.macro.capturing: Capturing: %s (click elsewhere to finish, Escape cancels)

command.merlinlib.list.header: MerlinLib enchantments present in the registry: %s
command.merlinlib.list.others: Enchantments of other mods / data packs in the registry (not vanilla, not managed by MerlinLib): %s
command.merlinlib.not_in_registry: %s is not in the enchantment registry
command.merlinlib.book.given: Gave the enchanted book of %s at level %s
command.merlinlib.player_only: This command can only be run by a player
command.merlinlib.pack.empty: The generated in-memory pack currently contains no files: check that config/MerlinLib/enchantments.json parses
command.merlinlib.editorhotkey.on: Item editor hotkey enabled (written to client.toml)
command.merlinlib.editorhotkey.off: Item editor hotkey disabled (written to client.toml)
merlinlib.notice.config_ui: MerlinLib: to keep the code small, the configuration screen was rebuilt for 0.9.0; on Forge and Fabric the visual configuration screen needs Cloth Config API or Jupiter. This notice can be switched off in the configuration file.
merlinlib.configuration.title: MerlinLib Settings
merlinlib.configuration.general.notice_e: Show the join notices MerlinLib sends, including the one about the configuration screen. Takes effect on the next join.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.crosshair_da: Show the damage of the weapon you just used near the crosshair.
How long the crosshair damage number stays on screen, in ticks.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.collapse_ena: Fold a very large health bar into one heart plus the current and maximum numbers.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.collapse_thr: Health above which the bar folds. 99 keeps a normal player bar untouched.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.armour_auto_: Move the armour row up so it sits on the folded health row.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.en: Show damage numbers flying off a mob when it is hit.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.du: How long a damage number stays visible after a mob is hit, in ticks.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.ba: Base scale of a damage number. Higher means larger text.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.no: ARGB colour of a normal hit, written as a signed 32 bit number.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.cr: ARGB colour of a critical hit, written as a signed 32 bit number.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.ma: Upper bound on simultaneous damage numbers; the oldest one is dropped first.
merlinlib.configuration.particles.limit_: Cap how many particles this client draws, so a single huge hit cannot freeze it.
How many particles may be drawn per 1/20 second.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.hotkey_en: Allow the editor hotkey to open the item editor. Off by default, so the library can be installed without claiming a key.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.shift_ste: Value change when a - or + button is clicked while holding shift.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.scroll_st: Value change per mouse wheel notch over a number field.
Value change per mouse wheel notch while holding ctrl.
merlinlib.configuration.macros.enabled.t: Enable the macro toolkit: the macro screen and running macros from their bound keys.
merlinlib.configuration.security.restric: When true, only operators may use the testing toolkit.
merlinlib.configuration.security.editor_: Require command permission (operator) to open the item editor.
merlinlib.configuration.security.health_: Require command permission (operator) to open the health editor.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.enable_tes: Master switch of the testing screens. The testing items stay in the creative tab.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.max_test_w: Upper bound for the damage value of the test weapons.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.max_enchan: Upper bound for enchantment levels set through the item editor.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_leve: When true, an enchantment may be raised above the maximum level its definition declares.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_mism: When true, any enchantment may be added to any item.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_edit: When true, the item editor opens for every item, including blocks.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_non_: Edit the damage of any weapon
When true, the base damage of an ordinary weapon can be edited too.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.health_edi: When true, the health editor only opens while holding the health editor item.
merlinlib.configuration.content.disable_: Emergency switch: when true, no enchantment defined in config/MerlinLib/*.json is generated. Code api registrations are unaffected.
Show the join notices business mods registered through MerlinLib. Turning it off silences every one of them; the switch of each mod is on the join notices page.
command.merlinlib.config.no_screen: MerlinLib: the visual configuration screen needs Cloth Config API or Jupiter. Without either, edit config/MerlinLib/client.toml and server.toml by hand.
gui.merlinlib.notices.title: Join notices
gui.merlinlib.notices.empty: No business mod needs its join notices configured
gui.merlinlib.notices.more: %s more mod(s) are not shown; config/MerlinLib/notices.toml holds them all
gui.merlinlib.notices.hint: The switches go to config/MerlinLib/notices.toml (one line per mod) and server.toml (the master switch), and apply on the next join. On a dedicated server, that server keeps its own configuration.
gui.merlinlib.notices.command_hint: Join notices: type /merlinlib notices to switch each mod on or off
